content: man7 findmnt(8): -n noheadings; -o SOURCE from kernel mountinfo shows device path backing a mount; -x/--verify checks /etc/fstab parsability and usability and also works with --tab-file; LIBMOUNT_FSTAB env overrides fstab path; exit 0 if something to display 1 on any error. Source: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/findmnt.8.html
